# The valley floor: a slab the size of the view whose top carries textures/ground.png (grass, the
# painted dirt path, flowers; drawn by make_env.py from the same layout as the game), and the grassy
# ridge along the back. make_env.py.
new
material new Ground --base-color 1 1 1 --no-slot
material texture Ground base-color textures/ground.png
material new Hill --base-color 0.4314 0.6667 0.4706 --no-slot
material new HillDark --base-color 0.3333 0.4392 0.3922 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name Ground --size 1 --location 0.000 -0.000 -0.15
scale 14.800 13.800 0.3
apply --scale
material assign Hill
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < 0.9"
delete only-faces
select all
select face where "normal.z > 0.9"
material assign Ground
uv project-from-view top --scale-to-bounds
mode object
add mesh ico-sphere --name Hill0 --subdivisions 1 --radius 1.2239 --location 0 0 0
set rotation 18.6 20.3 52.9
apply --rotation
scale 1.250 0.900 0.620
apply --scale
translate -7.6190 6.6379 0.0000
material assign HillDark
add mesh ico-sphere --name Hill1 --subdivisions 1 --radius 1.2048 --location 0 0 0
set rotation 31.7 3.8 27.3
apply --rotation
scale 1.250 0.900 0.620
apply --scale
translate -6.4761 6.7851 0.0000
material assign Hill

set rotation 1.7 39.3 86.8
apply --rotation

apply --scale

select Hill0 Hill1 Hill2 Hill3 Hill4 Hill5 Hill6 Hill7 Hill8 Hill9 Hill10 Hill11 Hill12
active Hill0
join
select Hill0
active Hill0
apply --location
mode edit
select face where "pos.z < 0.02 && normal.z < 0.3"
delete only-faces
mode object
select all
shade flat
export ground.glb
